messages:
maria: Heads-up — brought up nebula-embed-compact (float->int8) on staging. Holdout recall@5 tanked vs fp16. Quick paste of results and config, please eyeball.
ashok: Can you paste the exact commands + quantization config? Which backend (onnx/tensorrt)?
devon: Also which holdout set and preprocessing?
maria: Ran on TinyWiki holdout (10k). Pipeline identical to fp16: L2 normalize then index. Backend: ONNX runtime with custom int8 kernel. Command and config:
```
python eval.py --model nebula-compact --quant int8 --per_channel true --clamp 0.0 --backend onnx 
# calibration: calibrator.py --samples 1000 --mode static
```
Results (quick paste):
```
holdout: TinyWiki (n=10k)
fp16: R@1=0.622 R@5=0.871 R@10=0.917 mean_cosine=0.324 sil=0.21
int8: R@1=0.594 R@5=0.802 R@10=0.883 mean_cosine=0.295 sil=0.15
```
devon: Ugh that's a pretty noticeable drop at R@5. Did you run with the same preprocessing and index params?
maria: Yes — same ann index (HNSW, ef_search=128), same normalize step. UMAP shows cluster collapse — centroids closer, overall variance down (quick ascii):
```
fp16:  *   *    *    *  *   *
int8:   **  **  **  **
```
jia: What quant library was used? Static post-training or quant-aware finetune?
maria: Static post-training with per-channel scaling enabled. Calibration used 1k randomly-sampled docs (default ranges). clamp=0.0 (no extra clipping).
ashok: Two quick things to try: clamp=0.02 (small clipping of activations) and asymmetric vs symmetric quantization. Also test mixed-precision: int8 for matmuls, fp16 for residual paths.
maria: Re-ran with clamp=0.02, per_channel=true (same ONNX runtime). New numbers:
```
int8-clamp0.02: R@1=0.606 R@5=0.855 R@10=0.903 mean_cosine=0.312 sil=0.185
```
Better but still ~1.6% absolute R@5 gap vs fp16. Will do asymmetric + stratified calibration next.
devon: Calibration set composition can bias ranges — try stratified sampling across doc length and token distributions (long-tail examples can drive range). Also try symmetric vs asymmetric and per-tensor vs per-channel comparison.
jia: Also verify embedding similarity metric: ONNX int8 kernel might use dotproduct in downstream knn which differs if embeddings not normalized. Confirm index stores normalized vectors and search does cosine.
eval-bot: Note: created ticket #INFR-412 for nebula int8 onboarding; assigned to @maria and @ashok. :seedling:
maria: :thumbsup: I'll run asymmetric quant + stratified calib overnight and post numbers tomorrow. If that recovers R@5 to within 0.01 of fp16, we can mark int8 as admissible for Dedicated staging.
